patch.value: The package catalog went stale when pm-rl gained a hooks capability

value.author: claude
value.text: pm-rl merged an extension mutation guard on 2026-08-28 (unbraind/pm-rl#18), which added a hooks capability to its manifest.json. The catalog entry in src/services/package-catalog.ts still declared capabilities [commands, schema], so test/catalog.test.ts failed with: pm-rl: catalog capabilities must match manifest capabilities, actual [commands, hooks, schema] against expected [commands, schema]. Updated the entry to [commands, hooks, schema]. Worth noting the test did its job: this is a hand-maintained mirror of another repository's manifest, so it goes stale whenever any of the 20 packages changes its declared capabilities, and only this repository's own test notices. The catalog test is therefore the fleet's only detector for capability drift, and it can only run here.
